source: The granite is split open with splinters of rock jutting out at odd angles.
zh_CN: 花岗岩墙裂开，尖锐的碎石以不规则的角度凸出。

source: Ornate carpeting fills this room, a relic of ages past.
zh_CN: 这个房间铺满了华丽的地毯，是过去岁月的遗迹。

source: Light from the nearby crystals catches the grain of the lavish marble floor.
zh_CN: 附近水晶的光照亮了华丽大理石地面的纹理。

source: The rough stone wall is firm and unyielding.
zh_CN: 粗糙的石墙坚固而难以撼动。

source: you search your pack but do not have a matching key.
zh_CN: 你翻找背包，却没有匹配的钥匙。

source: stairs spiral downward into the depths.
zh_CN: 楼梯盘旋向下，进入深处。

source: the gilded doors leading out of the dungeon are sealed by an invisible force.
zh_CN: 通往地牢外的鎏金大门被一股无形的力量封住了。

source: dancing lights play across the plane of this sparkling crystal portal.
zh_CN: 晶莹的水晶传送门上流光舞动。

source: The torch is anchored firmly to the wall and sputters quietly in the gloom.
zh_CN: 火把牢牢地固定在墙上，在黑暗中静静地发出噼啪声。

source: You feel the crystal's glossy surface and admire the dancing lights beneath.
zh_CN: 你抚摸着水晶光滑的表面，欣赏其下跃动的光芒。

source: The iron bars rattle but will not budge; they are firmly locked in place.
zh_CN: 铁栅栏哐当作响，却纹丝不动，显然被牢牢锁住了。

source: The wooden barricade is firmly set but has dried over the years. Might it burn?
zh_CN: 木路障虽然牢固，多年来却已干燥。它会烧起来吗？

source: The torch is anchored firmly to the wall, and sputters quietly in the gloom.
zh_CN: 火把牢牢地固定在墙上，在黑暗中静静地发出噼啪声。

source: The torch lies at the foot of the wall, spouting gouts of flame haphazardly.
zh_CN: 火把倒在墙根，胡乱喷吐着一团团火焰。

source: A dim purple flame sputters and spits atop this wall-mounted torch.
zh_CN: 这支壁挂火把上的暗紫色火焰噼啪作响。

source: The cold marble statue has weathered the years with grace.
zh_CN: 冰冷的大理石雕像优雅地经受了岁月的考验。

source: Deep cracks ramble down the side of the statue even as you watch.
zh_CN: 你眼看着雕像侧面的深深裂纹蜿蜒而下。

source: This ancient moss-covered stone archway radiates a strange, alien energy.
zh_CN: 这座长满青苔的古老石拱门散发着奇异的异界能量。

source: a gilded altar is adorned with candles that flicker in the breeze.
zh_CN: 镀金的祭坛上装饰着在微风中闪烁的蜡烛。

source: ornate gilding spirals around a spherical depression in the top of the altar.
zh_CN: 祭坛顶部的球形凹槽周围，盘绕着精美的镀金花纹。

source: a cage, open on the bottom, hangs over this altar on a retractable chain.
zh_CN: 一个底部敞开的笼子用一条可伸缩的链条悬挂在祭坛上方。

source: the missing item must be replaced before you can access the remaining items.
zh_CN: 必须先补回取走的物品，才能取用其余物品。

source: a weathered stone altar is adorned with candles that flicker in the breeze.
zh_CN: 风化的石头祭坛上装饰着在微风中闪烁的蜡烛。

source: the cage won't budge. Perhaps there is a way to raise it nearby...
zh_CN: 笼子纹丝不动。附近也许有办法把它升起来……

source: elaborate carvings wind around this ancient pedestal.
zh_CN: 这座古老基座上雕刻着繁复的纹样。

source: the interior of the cage is filthy and reeks of decay.
zh_CN: 笼子内部肮脏不堪，散发着腐烂的臭味。

source: the bars of the cage are firmly set and will not budge.
zh_CN: 笼子的栅栏固定得牢固，不会移动。

source: a coffin made from thick wooden planks rests in a bed of moss.
zh_CN: 一口厚木板制成的棺材放在苔藓床上。

source: an open wooden coffin rests in a bed of moss.
zh_CN: 一口敞开的木棺放在苔藓床上。

source: there is a hidden pressure plate in the floor above a reserve of caustic gas.
zh_CN: 腐蚀性气体储槽上方的地板里，藏着一块压力板。

source: you plunge through a hidden trap door!
zh_CN: 你从隐藏的活板门中直坠而下！

source: you plunge through a hole in the ground!
zh_CN: 你从地上的一个洞里跳了进去！

source: there is a hidden pressure plate in the floor.
zh_CN: 地板上有一个隐藏的压力板。

source: A dormant gas vent is connected to a reserve of paralytic gas.
zh_CN: 一个休眠的排气口连接着麻痹气体储罐。

source: A hidden pressure plate accompanies a reserve of psychotropic gas.
zh_CN: 隐藏的压力板下连着一罐致幻气体。

source: A hidden pressure plate is connected to a crude flamethrower mechanism.
zh_CN: 一个隐藏的压力板连接到一个粗糙的火焰喷射器机构。

source: A hidden pressure plate is connected to floodgates in the walls and ceiling.
zh_CN: 隐藏的压力板连接到墙壁和天花板上的水闸。

source: you see netting subtly concealed in the ceiling over a hidden pressure plate.
zh_CN: 你看见隐藏的压力板上方，天花板里巧妙地藏着一张网。

source: a hidden pressure plate is connected to a loud alarm mechanism.
zh_CN: 隐藏的压力板连接到响亮的警报装置。

source: An inactive gas vent is hidden in a crevice in the ground.
zh_CN: 地面裂缝里藏着一个未启动的排气孔。

source: Clouds of caustic gas are wafting out of a hidden vent in the floor.
zh_CN: 腐蚀性气体云从地板上隐藏的通风口中飘出。

source: Clouds of explosive gas are wafting out of a hidden vent in the floor.
zh_CN: 爆炸性气体云从地板上隐藏的通风口中飘出。

source: A natural crevice in the floor periodically vents scalding gouts of steam.
zh_CN: 地面上的天然裂隙会定期喷出滚烫的蒸汽。

source: There is an exposed pressure plate here. A thrown item might trigger it.
zh_CN: 这里有一块裸露的压力板。扔出的物品可能会触发它。

source: This pressure plate has already been depressed.
zh_CN: 这块压力板已经被压下。

source: A strange glyph, engraved into the floor, flickers with magical light.
zh_CN: 地板上刻着一枚奇异符文，闪烁着魔法光芒。

source: A strange glyph, engraved into the floor, radiates magical light.
zh_CN: 地板上刻着一枚奇异符文，散发着魔法光芒。

source: a glass dewar of caustic gas
zh_CN: 一只装有腐蚀气体的玻璃瓶

source: a glass dewar of confusion gas
zh_CN: 一只装有混乱气体的玻璃瓶

source: a glass dewar of paralytic gas
zh_CN: 一只装有麻痹气体的玻璃瓶

source: a glass dewar of methane gas
zh_CN: 一只装有甲烷的玻璃瓶

source: the current tugs you in all directions.
zh_CN: 水流将你朝各个方向拉扯。

source: the water is cold and reaches your knees.
you are knee-deep in thick, foul-smelling mud.
zh_CN: 你正陷在齐膝深、散发着恶臭的泥浆里。

source: you plunge downward into the chasm!
chilly winds blow upward from the stygian depths.
zh_CN: 幽冥深处吹来阵阵寒风。

source: cracks are appearing in the ground beneath your feet!
zh_CN: 你脚下的地面开始出现裂缝！

source: searing heat rises from the lava.
zh_CN: 熔岩中升腾起灼热气浪。

source: sunlight streams through cracks in the ceiling.
zh_CN: 阳光从天花板的裂缝间倾泻而下。

source: this area happens to be cloaked in shadows -- perhaps a safe place to hide.
zh_CN: 这里恰好笼罩在阴影中——或许是藏身的安全之处。

source: the jagged brimstone hisses and spits ominously as it crunches under your feet.
zh_CN: 锯齿状的硫磺在你脚下嘎吱作响，不祥地嘶鸣并迸出火星。

source: the ground has fused into obsidian.
the rickety rope bridge creaks underfoot.
zh_CN: 摇摇晃晃的索桥在脚下吱吱作响。

source: the bridge is plunging into the chasm before your eyes!
zh_CN: 这座桥正在你眼前陷入深渊！

source: the rickety rope bridge is staked to the edge of the chasm.
zh_CN: 摇摇欲坠的绳桥被木桩固定在深渊边缘。

source: the narrow stone bridge winds precariously across the chasm.
zh_CN: 狭窄的石桥摇摇欲坠地横跨深渊。

source: a sheet of ice extends into the water, ripples frozen into its glossy surface.
zh_CN: 一片冰层伸入水中，涟漪凝结在光滑的冰面上。

source: cracks extend across the surface of the ice as it melts before your eyes.
zh_CN: 冰在你眼前融化，裂纹蔓延至整个冰面。

source: you plunge downward into the hole!
chilly gusts of air blow upward through the translucent floor.
zh_CN: 冷风阵阵穿过半透明的地板向上吹来。

source: knee-deep water drains slowly into holes in the floor.
zh_CN: 齐膝深的水正缓缓流入地板上的洞里。
草状的真菌在脚下嘎吱作响。
枯死的真菌覆盖着地面。

source: groping tendrils of pale fungus rise from the muck.
zh_CN: 苍白真菌的触须从泥沼中探出，向上伸展。

source: luminescent fungus casts a pale, eerie glow.
zh_CN: 发光真菌发出苍白、怪异的光芒。

source: venomous barbs cover the quivering tendrils of this fast-growing lichen.
zh_CN: 这种迅速蔓延的地衣卷须上布满毒刺，正微微颤动。

source: a pile of hay, matted with filth, has been arranged here as a makeshift bed.
zh_CN: 这里铺着一堆沾满污秽的干草，权作临时床铺。

source: the floor is splattered with blood.
the floor is splattered with green blood.
zh_CN: 地板上溅满了绿色的血。

source: the floor is splattered with purple blood.
zh_CN: 地板上溅满了紫色的血。

source: the floor is splattered with acid.
the floor is caked with vomit.
a puddle of urine covers the ground.
a pile of lavender-scented unicorn poop sparkles with rainbow light.
zh_CN: 一堆带着薰衣草香气的独角兽粪便闪烁着彩虹般的光芒。
蠕虫的内脏散落在地上。
木炭和灰烬在脚下嘎吱作响。

source: the carpet has been scorched by an ancient fire.
zh_CN: 地毯已被远古之火烧焦。

source: a puddle of water covers the ground.
unidentifiable bones, yellowed with age, litter the ground.
zh_CN: 地上散落着一堆无法辨认、因年代久远而泛黄的骨头。
地面上覆盖着岩石碎石。

source: primitive tools, carvings and trinkets are strewn about the area.
zh_CN: 原始工具、雕刻品和小饰物散落在四周。

source: jagged chunks of glass from the broken dewar litter the ground.
zh_CN: 破碎玻璃瓶的锯齿状碎片散落在地上。

source: a thick, glowing substance has congealed on the ground.
zh_CN: 地面上凝结了一层厚厚的发光物质。
地面上散落着噼啪作响的余烬。

source: thick, sticky spiderwebs fill the area.
zh_CN: 厚厚的、粘稠的蜘蛛网布满了整个区域。

source: a dense tangle of netting fills the area.
zh_CN: 整个区域布满了密密麻麻的网。

source: dense foliage fills the area, thriving on what sunlight trickles in.
zh_CN: 茂密植被铺满这片区域，靠着透入的些许阳光生长。

source: the decaying husk of a fungal growth fills the area.
zh_CN: 腐朽的真菌残骸覆盖了这片区域。

source: luminescent fungal growth fills the area, groping upward from the rich soil.
zh_CN: 发光真菌从肥沃的土壤中向上蔓生，铺满了这片区域。

source: The translucent green crystal is melting away in front of your eyes.
zh_CN: 半透明的绿色水晶在你眼前融化。

source: a sacred glyph adorns the floor, glowing with a powerful warding enchantment.
zh_CN: 地板上刻着一枚神圣符文，闪耀着强大的守护魔法。

source: a thick iron manacle is anchored to the ceiling.
zh_CN: 一副粗重的铁镣固定在天花板上。

source: a thick iron manacle is anchored to the floor.
zh_CN: 一副粗重的铁镣固定在地板上。

source: a thick iron manacle is anchored to the wall.
zh_CN: 一副粗重的铁镣固定在墙上。

source: blinding light streams out of the archway.
zh_CN: 令人眼花缭乱的光芒从拱门中射出。

source: a red glow fills the area.
zh_CN: 红色的光芒充满了整个区域。

source: sulfurous flames leap from the unstable bed of brimstone.
zh_CN: 硫磺火焰从不稳定的硫磺层中腾起。

source: billowing infernal flames eat at the floor.
zh_CN: 滚滚地狱火吞噬着地板。

source: burning gas fills the air with flame.
zh_CN: 燃烧的气体令空气中火焰翻腾。

source: the force of the explosion slams into you.
flames burst out of the incendiary dart.
zh_CN: 火焰从燃烧飞镖中喷出。

source: crackling flames rise from the blackened item.
zh_CN: 噼啪作响的火焰从烧黑的物品上升起。

source: greasy flames rise from the corpse.
you can feel the purple gas eating at your flesh.
zh_CN: 你可以感觉到紫色气体正在侵蚀你的肉体。

source: the rainbow-colored gas tickles your brain.
zh_CN: 彩虹色气体刺激着你的脑神经。

source: the stench of rotting flesh is overpowering.
zh_CN: 腐肉的恶臭令人难以忍受。

source: you retch violently at the smell of the greasy smoke.
zh_CN: 你一闻到油腻的烟味就剧烈地干呕。

source: the pale gas causes your muscles to stiffen.
zh_CN: 苍白的气体会使你的肌肉僵硬。

source: the smell of explosive swamp gas fills the air.
zh_CN: 空气中弥漫着爆炸性沼泽气体的气味。
空气中弥漫着滚烫的蒸汽！

source: everything is obscured by an aura of supernatural darkness.
zh_CN: 超自然的黑暗笼罩一切。

source: bloodwort spores, renowned for their healing properties, fill the air.
zh_CN: 以疗愈功效闻名的血草孢子弥漫在空气中。

source: this spindly plant grows seed pods famous for their healing properties.
zh_CN: 这种细长植物会结出以疗伤功效闻名的种荚。

source: the bloodwort seed pod bursts, releasing a cloud of healing spores.
zh_CN: 血草种荚裂开，释放出一团疗伤孢子。

source: a bedroll lies in the corner, disintegrating with age.
zh_CN: 角落里有一卷铺盖，已随着岁月侵蚀而逐渐散架。

source: blooming algae fills the waters with a swirling luminescence.
zh_CN: 繁盛的藻类让水中泛起旋转的荧光。

source: thorned vines make a rustling noise as they quiver restlessly.
zh_CN: 带刺的藤蔓不安地颤抖，发出沙沙的声音。

source: tufts of lush grass have improbably pushed upward through the stone ground.
zh_CN: 一丛丛茂盛的草竟从石地上冒了出来。

source: crude diagrams on this altar and its twin invite you to place items upon them.
zh_CN: 这座祭坛和它的双生祭坛上刻着简陋图案，示意你把物品放上去。

source: scorch marks cover the surface of the altar, but it is cold to the touch.
zh_CN: 祭坛表面布满了焦痕，但摸上去却是冰凉的。

source: glass pipes are set into the floor and emit a soft glow of shifting color.
zh_CN: 玻璃管镶嵌在地板上，发出柔和的变色光芒。

source: the inside of the glass pipes are charred.
the souls of the dead surround you. A deceased ally might be called back.
zh_CN: 死者的灵魂环绕着你。或许可以召回一位逝去的盟友。
恶魔学符号装饰着这座祭坛。

source: the smell of burnt flesh lingers over this pit of lava.
zh_CN: 这个熔岩坑上空弥漫着肉被烧焦的味道。

source: An obsidian statue of a leering demon looms over the room.
zh_CN: 一尊狞笑着的恶魔黑曜石雕像高高耸立，俯视着整个房间。

source: Once magnificent, the statue has crumbled beyond recognition.
zh_CN: 这尊雕像曾经宏伟壮丽，如今已碎裂得面目全非。

source: the narrow stone bridge is extending across the chasm.
zh_CN: 狭窄的石桥正向深渊对岸延伸。

source: Cracks are running ominously across the base of this rough stone wall.
zh_CN: 这堵粗糙的石墙的底部出现了不祥的裂缝。

source: A slight electric shock startles you when you touch the inert crystal globe.
zh_CN: 你触碰这颗失去活性的水晶球时，被轻微电了一下。

source: Crackling light streams out of the crystal globe.
zh_CN: 水晶球中迸出噼啪作响的电光。

source: The ancient brazier smolders with a deep crimson flame.
zh_CN: 古老的火盆冒着深红色的火焰。

source: Rotting animal matter has been ground into the mud floor; the stench is awful.
zh_CN: 腐烂的动物残骸被碾进泥地，恶臭难当。

source: A malodorous layer of clay and fecal matter coats the wall.
zh_CN: 墙面覆着一层恶臭的黏土和粪污。

source: you push through the animal skins that hang across the threshold.
zh_CN: 你拨开横挂在门口的兽皮。

source: The corpse detonates with terrifying force!
Poisonous spores burst from the corpse!
zh_CN: 有毒孢子从尸体中迸发！

source: the dewar shatters and pressurized caustic gas explodes outward!
zh_CN: 玻璃瓶碎裂，加压的腐蚀气体向外爆开！

source: the dewar shatters and pressurized confusion gas explodes outward!
zh_CN: 玻璃瓶碎裂，加压的混乱气体向外爆开！

source: the dewar shatters and pressurized paralytic gas explodes outward!
zh_CN: 玻璃瓶碎裂，加压的麻痹气体向外爆开！

source: the dewar shatters and pressurized methane gas explodes outward!
zh_CN: 玻璃瓶碎裂，加压的甲烷气体向外爆开！

source: the cages lift off of the altars as you approach.
zh_CN: 你靠近时，笼子从祭坛上升起。

source: the cages lower to cover the altars.
the altar retracts into the ground with a grinding sound.
zh_CN: 祭坛嘎吱作响，缩回地面。

source: the archway flashes, and you catch a glimpse of another world!
zh_CN: 拱门闪烁，你看到了另一个世界！

source: the glyph beneath you glows, and the guardians take a step!
zh_CN: 你脚下的符文亮起，守卫者们迈出一步！

source: the mirrored totem flashes, reflecting the red glow of the glyph beneath you.
zh_CN: 镜像图腾闪烁，映出你脚下符文的红光。

source: you notice a lever hidden behind a loose stone in the wall.
zh_CN: 你注意到墙上一块松动的石头后藏着一根拉杆。

source: the rope bridge snaps from the heat and plunges into the chasm!
zh_CN: 绳桥因高温而折断，坠入深渊！

source: the area is flooded as water rises through imperceptible holes in the ground.
zh_CN: 水从地面上不起眼的孔洞中涌出，淹没了这片区域。

source: a cloud of caustic gas sprays upward from the floor!
zh_CN: 一团腐蚀性气体从地板向上喷射！

source: a sparkling cloud of confusion gas sprays upward from the floor!
zh_CN: 一团闪闪发光的混乱气体从地板上向上喷射！

source: a net falls from the ceiling!
zh_CN: 一张网从天花板掉下来！

source: a piercing shriek echoes through the nearby rooms!
zh_CN: 刺耳的尖叫声在附近的房间里回荡！

source: the items on the two altars flash with a brilliant light!
zh_CN: 两座祭坛上的物品同时闪耀出炫目的光芒！

source: An old friend emerges from a bloom of sacred light!
zh_CN: 一位老朋友从神圣之光的绽放中出现！

source: a demonic presence whispers its demand: "Bring to me the marked sacrifice!"
zh_CN: 一个恶魔般的存在低声提出要求：“把被标记的祭品带给我！”

source: demonic cackling echoes through the room as the altar plunges downward!
zh_CN: 祭坛向下沉去，恶魔般的狂笑声在房间中回荡！

source: the coffin opens and a dark figure rises!
zh_CN: 棺材打开，一道黑影升起！

source: as flames begin to lick the coffin, its tenant bursts forth!
zh_CN: 火焰开始舔舐棺材时，里面的东西猛然冲了出来！

source: the cage lifts off of the altar.
a scratching sound emanates from the nearby walls!
zh_CN: 附近的墙后传来抓挠声！

source: flames quickly consume the wooden barricade.

source: This legendary bird shines with a brilliant light, and $HISHER wings crackle and pop like embers as they beat the air. When $HESHE dies, legend has it that an egg will form and a newborn phoenix will rise from its ashes.
zh_CN: 这只传奇之鸟光芒万丈，拍打双翼时，$HISHER翅膀如余烬般噼啪作响。传说$HESHE死后会结出一枚蛋，新生凤凰将从灰烬中升起。

source: Cradled in a nest of cooling ashes, the translucent membrane of the phoenix egg reveals a yolk that glows brighter by the second.
zh_CN: 凤凰蛋安卧在渐冷的灰烬巢中，透过半透明的蛋壳薄膜，可以看见蛋黄每一秒都变得更加明亮。

source: bursts as a newborn phoenix rises from the ashes!
zh_CN: 蛋壳轰然迸裂，新生凤凰从灰烬中升起！

source: This mangrove dryad is as old as the earth, and $HISHER gnarled figure houses an ancient power. When angered, $HESHE can call upon the forces of nature to bind $HISHER foes and tear them to shreds.
zh_CN: 这株红树林树精与大地同寿，$HISHER盘虬身躯蕴藏着古老力量。被激怒时，$HESHE能召唤自然之力束缚$HISHER敌人，再将其撕碎。

zh_CN: 一种罕见的突变会使$HIMHER在$HESHE死亡时发生剧烈爆炸。

zh_CN: 致命地衣孢子已感染$HESHE；$HISHER尸体会在$HESHE死亡后散播有毒真菌。

source: A rare mutation greatly enhances $HISHER mobility.

zh_CN: 一种罕见突变使$HISHER肉体硬化，提升$HISHER生命值与力量，却降低$HISHER速度。

source: A rare mutation has caused suckered tentacles to sprout from $HISHER frame, increasing $HISHER health and allowing $HIMHER to grapple with $HISHER prey.
zh_CN: 一种罕见突变使$HISHER躯体长出带吸盘的触手，提高$HISHER生命值，并让$HIMHER能擒住$HISHER猎物。

source: A rare mutation allows $HIMHER to heal $HIMSELFHERSELF with every attack.
zh_CN: 一种罕见的突变使得 $HIMHER 每次攻击都能治愈 $HIMSELFHERSELF。

source: A rare mutation causes $HIMHER to poison $HISHER victims and sap their strength with every attack.
zh_CN: 一种罕见的突变让$HIMHER每次攻击都能使$HISHER受害者中毒并削弱其力量。

source: A rare mutation has coated $HISHER flesh with reflective scales.
zh_CN: 一种罕见突变使$HISHER的皮肤覆上反光鳞片。
